featured_reviews.review_text: Guru Nanak Gurudwara is peaceful and beautifully maintained. The environment is welcoming, and the langar service is heartwarming. A serene place for spiritual reflection and community gatherings. ✨️

featured_reviews.name: Yours Truly Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Vasai West Gurudwara today on the auspicious occasion of Guru Nanak Jayanti and, as usual, it was decorated so beautifully.
One must appreciate the efforts taken by the Gurudwara Committee in ensuring that safety as well as rituals are taken care of.Right from holy prayer(paath) till the Langar(which was take away like last year due to Covid Restrictions?) everything was arranged exceptionally well. Also since Guru Nanak jayanti is celebrated by Sindhis also, Gurudwara gets twice the number of people (Sangat) than usual, yet they manage it so well

featured_reviews.name: Ramandeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This Gurudwara is located right along the Vasai West highway, making it very easy to access. There is plenty of parking available, though it can get quite crowded during festival seasons. The Langar Hall is on the ground floor, and Gurbani Kirtan takes place on the first floor, creating a peaceful and spiritual atmosphere.

The restrooms were neat and clean, and langar is available most of the time, which is greatly appreciated by visitors. Overall, the place is well-maintained and offers the same warmth and serenity you’d expect from any Gurudwara.

A calm and welcoming space for everyone.

featured_reviews.name: KPOP FAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Beautiful place and the trustee and managing committee are so down to earth.... I as a Non-Sikh loved this place
During Sikh festivals they whole heartedly welcome you to have their public langar with so much affection that if you don't have it would poke you many times that such lovely people invited us and we didn't go
A must visit if want to see unity in diversity of India

featured_reviews.name: Atine De
featured_reviews.review_text: Good place to meditate and pray. It's peaceful and serene. Very well maintained and clean. Sikhism is practised here. It's the abode for the Guru Nanak's teachings. People mainly the natives and their descendants follow this beautiful religion. They are kind and loving people. Parking is a crunch.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very calm place,  serene,  pure to the core... Positive vibrations, bright , very well maintained,  spacious, once you are inside,  leave all your worries to him with clean n pure heart & you are sure to be stress free

featured_reviews.name: Aman Chhabra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Satnam Sri Waheguru. Blessed to have a serene feeling when you listen to the paath early in the morning. Followed by the Dewan in the late morning with Guru ka langar in place every Sunday. Loved the sangat who were there, providing sewa and the management who all are soft spoken.
